AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:instructions:
MovieGallery is a movie discovery app backed by The Movie Database (TMDB). Its functions search movies, list and add to the user's watchlist, and open a movie's details screen.
Operational patterns: - Movies are identified by their TMDB movie ID. 'searchMovies' returns it as 'movieId', which 'addToWatchlist' and 'openMovieDetails' take. - 'searchMovies' already returns each movie's year, rating, genres and synopsis, so a search answers most questions about a movie without opening it. - 'addToWatchlist' is idempotent: calling it for a movie already on the watchlist changes nothing.
Constraints: - The watchlist belongs to the account signed in to MovieGallery. 'getWatchlist' and 'addToWatchlist' fail when no one is signed in; signing in is only possible in the app. - Every function except 'getWatchlist' needs a network connection to TMDB.
